title: Wildboyz Entertainment Mixtape
note: Feb 2013. 12 tracks plus 2 bonus. THE RICHEST SINGLE TRACKLIST IN THE ARCHIVE and the clearest evidence of the Mandalay underground network. Full lineup: 01 Good Morning (Mg Moe Aung & Alatt feat Dr.13); 02 Show Me What You Got (Alatt, TMH, Channel, Oasix); 03 Marico (Mg Moe Aung & Mg Archi); 04 Rap ဆိုမွာလား (Thu Rain); 05 တံၿမက္စည္း ၾကက္ေမြွး (Mg Moe Aung, Plus, Sai Nay); 06 She Is My Girl (Oasix); 07 Like Dreams (Dr.13); 08 UnderGround Student (Y-Zet, Alone, Mg Hann Saw); 09 ဒီညေတာ႔ေကာင္းၿပီ (Y-Zet & Lout Lout); 10 She Loved Me Just 14 Days (Mg Moe Aung, Channel, Alatt feat Mg Archi); 11 ခ်စ္မိသူ (Sai Nay); 12 သူငယ္ခ်င္း (Phyo Wai & Mg Pyae Phyo); bonus Boucher (Dudue, Oo Fat, Lout Lout, Mg Hann Saw, Oasix, Channel); bonus တာလိုက္ (Oo Fat, Mg Hann Saw, Lout Lout). Oasix is the lead credit because he is the most prominent member, not because the release is his alone - this is a crew compilation and is recorded as such. Tracklist corroborated across two independent fan-archive mirrors.

The Mandalay crew's debut and the archive's proof that a distinct Mandalay Rapperz Crew existed alongside the Yangon M.R.C (Nine Win) with the same initials. Members: Ye' Myat, Na Yem, Na Jyam, Nga Ye', Aung Phyo, Kyaw Zin, Yan Naing, Doe-Z, Thiri Yadanar, Su Thet Nge, guest No No.

title: Thar Nge (MC Family) Mixtape
